items.title: Luke Schiro Interview, 1967-12-05
items.q: See Alna Riega was also a real good dresser.

ctx.x: Beautiful little blonde. And she was about 16 years old. She used to like me a lot. An old man found out about it. And he put a stout to it. Yeah. I couldn't stand for that. No. But boy she could dress. And I used to dress at the time myself. I was one of the best dressed in the city. I mean for amateur musicians at the time. And you know. And that. See Alna Riega was also a real good dresser. They used to have around eight tailor made suits, about 75 Irish shirts with other accessories, and about three or four…
Well that's a lot of money. Everything went bad then, I mean.
